launchAdaptation.reason: Original pnpm test stopped before tests because tsx CLI tried to create a Unix IPC socket prohibited in this host.
launchAdaptation.shim:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
if [ "$1" = '-c' ]; then
  script=$2
  shift 2
  exec /bin/bash -c 'tsx() { command node --import tsx "$@"; }
'"$script" -- "$@"
fi
exec /bin/bash "$@"
launchAdaptation.scope: Maps the tsx shell command to node --import tsx; preserves pnpm test, its build prerequisites, and all base source.
